summary: Three-person climbing party ascending the bolted 5.7 sport route 'Hasta la Vista Amichi' (four pitches, 400 vertical ft) above Officer's Gulch on the west side of the Tenmile Range near Frisco when one climber fell and was pronounced deceased at the scene. The fallen climber (Rick Karden, 57, Summit teacher/author, per Krystal93; sheriff release withheld identity) had most of the group's gear, stranding the other two climbers; Summit County Sheriff's deputies and the Summit County Rescue Group evacuated the two uninjured survivors in a ~4-hour mission and recovered the body. Coroner to determine cause/manner.
location: Hasta la Vista Amichi, above Officer's Gulch, Tenmile Range
responding_agency: Summit County Sheriff's Office; Summit County Rescue Group
